content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Constants and Top-Level Declarations** as part of **Kotlin Syntax and Basic Structure**. `const val` is for compile-time constants of supported types and must be declared in a permitted location; ordinary `val` can be initialized at runtime. Use the subtopics—Top-Level Properties, Compile-Time Constants with const val, Initialization Rules—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
